source_refs.note: The Photon: a main subheading of 18.1 Quantum Theory of Radiation, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Planck ne socha ke jaise matter (maddah) lagataar nahi balke bohat se nanhe particles se bana hai, isi tarah kisi source se nikalne wali radiation energy bhi granular (daane daane wali) hai. Un ke khayal mein garam cheezon ki radiation ki yeh particle wali nature (fitrat) un atoms ki kisi property (khasiyat) ki wajah se thi jo radiation paida karte hain. Einstein ne yeh khayal aage barhaya: energy ke yeh chhote bundles har electromagnetic radiation ka hissa hain aur inhein aur chhote hisson mein sub-divide (taqseem) nahi kiya ja sakta. In na tootne wale bundles ko unhon ne "photons" kaha. Wavelength λ wali roshni ki beam photons ki ek stream (dhaara) hai jo speed c se chalti hai, aur har photon ki energy E = hf hai.
Theory of relativity se E = mc², aur photon ka relativistic momentum p = mc hai. In dono ko milayen (mc² = (mc)c = pc) to:
E = hf rakhein to pc = hf, yani p = hf/c. Ab c = fλ hai, is liye f/c = 1/λ:

blocks.latex: \text{Thus}\quad pc = hf \quad\text{or}\quad p = hf/c \qquad \text{Since}\quad c = f\lambda,\quad \text{therefore,}
blocks.text_alt: Thus pc = hf or p = hf/c. Since c = fλ, therefore,

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Photon ka koi rest mass nahi, phir bhi us ke paas momentum p = E/c = h/λ hota hai. Isi liye roshni jis surface (satah) par parti hai us par halki si force (aur pressure) laga sakti hai. Wavelength chhoti ho to momentum zyada.

Quantum theory har system par lagayi ja sakti hai, maslan spring par oscillate karta (jhoolta) mass. Lekin wahan energy ke steps itne chhote hain ke detect (pakde) nahi kiye ja sakte, is liye particle wali nature nazar nahi aati. Quantum effects (asraat) sirf atom jitni chhoti cheezon mein ahem hain, jahan energy ki har measurable (napi ja sakne wali) tabdeeli mein h ka hissa significant (numayan) hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 600 nm wavelength wale photon ki energy aur momentum nikalein.

items: Planck (1901): energy quanta mein, E = hf (18.1), h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.
Einstein: roshni photons ki stream; photon toota nahi ja sakta.
Photon ka momentum: E = pc (18.2), p = h/λ (18.3).
Quantum effects sirf atom jitni cheezon mein nazar aate hain.
